info.name: The Lost Seal Stone of Ellin Forest

descriptions.notStarted: It turns out that the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest was taken by #o9300353# of the Black Wings. How did this happen? You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k in Ellin Forest.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2131000# reveals that she has a letter that contains information about another Seal Stone and promises to hand it to you. Unfortunately, you can't take the letter since #b#p2131000# and you are from two separate times#k. \n\nJust when you think it's all over, #p2131000# tells you that she's a fairy with a very long life, and that she will in fact carry the letter to your time. What you need to do now is leave Ellin Forest and #bmeet #p2131000# in your own time#k. You wonder where #p2131000# is? You'd better ask #b#p1002104##k.
descriptions.completed: You asked #p1002104# whether he knew anyone named #p2131000#. It turned out that #p1002104# is one of the most well-known people in all of Victoria Island. You should head to #m100000201# in #m100000000# to meet Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School.
